svg.text: USB 2L: actual reference copper and available return corridors
First USB geometry snapshot; final 2L must be rechecked. Not an SI/impedance result.
TOP GND reference / BOTTOM DP mirror
BOTTOM GND reference / TOP DP entry
Green: actual GND copper. Gold: verified available GND corridor.
Purple/blue: projected DP/DM from opposite signal layer. White: holes / reference voids.
Mirror: 1.0 mm planar bridge has no direct vertical plane cover at the via antipads.
ESD VBUS bottom crossing: DP reference gap 1.34262 mm; a 0.30 mm copper corridor goes around it.
Corridors demonstrate available copper only; HF current is not constrained to these drawn polylines.
